reviews.text: The tandoori tadka burger and cheesy garlic bread are unbeatable in Kothariya! Freshly made, crispy patty, and authentic taste every single visit.
Best fast food spot near Rolex Road. The cheese burst pizza had plenty of toppings and the indori jumbo sandwich was super loaded. Quick service!
Clean kitchen and warm hospitality. The fries were hot and fresh, and Korean burger is something you won't find anywhere else in this area at this price.
Delicious burgers and pocket-friendly pricing right next to Axis bank. Great evening hangout place with friends in Kothariya.
